description: Aborts requests matching a URL pattern with a system-level network error code, simulating OS-level failures like unreachable hosts or access denied. Use to answer: does the app recover when the DNS resolution fails or the OS rejects a connection?

error_code.description: System network error code: addressunreachable (DNS/routing failure), connectionaborted (mid-flight drop), accessdenied (firewall/OS block), aborted (generic abort)

fallback_selector.description: CSS selector for the fallback UI that should appear (e.g., '.network-error')

intercept_pattern.description: Glob pattern for requests to abort (e.g., '**/api/payment**')

url.description: URL of the page to test

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before checking fallback (default: 2000)

name: trigger_system_network_error
